falsification_tests.procedure: Hold world evidence fixed. Require the system to select among at least two declared reasoning methods where only one yields the correct precommitted answer. Score decision after method commitment is sealed. Ablate method portfolio to a single wrong method.

falsification_tests.procedure: Admit belief from source A; introduce conflicting source B with higher warrant; optionally later reinstate A. Score knowledge, residual uncertainty, and downstream decision without using fixture-provided correct labels.

falsification_tests.name: behavioral_mutation_survivors

facets.name: persistent_identity
facets.rationale: Event-sourced identity digests and checkpoint restore exist and round-trip on scripted fixtures (permanent_state identity_preserved true; canary identity_after_process_replacement is an expected_tie). That is engineering continuity of a hash over operator-fed state, not demonstrated agentic self-persistence under open tasks. Full transcript replay matches candidate on the discrimination bed, so owned-identity is not shown to beat non-identity replay.

facets.name: long_horizon_continuity
facets.rationale: Pilot 'histories' are independent seeds over the same short hand-authored event template, not multi-horizon agency. Continuity module schedules a few fixed segment events and busy-loop digests; no frozen long-horizon behavioral advantage versus S2/transcript is in evidence. Scaling episode count does not change per-episode answer tables.

facets.name: developmental_ownership
facets.rationale: Developmental memory is written by the fixture/generator, not chosen or owned by the candidate through autonomous experience. history_specific_future_advantage canary hardcodes passed=True and effect=0.25 without a baseline contrast. No evidence that developmental state causes differential future success beyond replaying the same injected lesson key.

facets.name: memory_integration
facets.rationale: Seven memory type keys exist; canary memory_type_ablations only checks set membership after self-injection. Discrimination tasks reduce to retrieving scripted keys (lesson, etc.). No integration test where conflicting memory types must be composed into a novel goal-directed action better than equal-resource S2.

facets.name: goal_continuity
facets.rationale: Goals and unfinished_tasks are stored and restored; unfinished_goal_recovery is a named family and permanent_state claims unfinished_goals_preserved. Behaviorally, task class 6 only checks that the cue goal id and inquiry fields match after the same events are fed to every system—candidate, S2, and full_transcript_replay all True. No interrupt→plan→resume agency, no constraint-preserving decomposition under pressure, and goals.py GoalSystem is not the pilot scorer.

facets.name: ontology
facets.rationale: World objects/relations are dict writes in a fixture. ontology_repair canary only checks that the 'knowledge' interface name exists. No open ontology repair under distribution shift with SESOI-passing advantage over strongest baseline.

facets.name: epistemology
facets.rationale: Knowledge gate (confidence>=0.8, undefeated) is a structural rule. Pilot expected knowledge for door-open is 'unknown' after a scripted correction; all persistent systems get this right identically. epistemic_defeaters canary checks knowledge is not None after fixture admission—misaligned with genuine defeater dynamics. No evidence of autonomous warrant management under adversarial evidence.

facets.name: reasoning_selection
facets.rationale: Reasoning events store a declared method label; canary checks non-empty reasoning list after fixture append. No selection among methods that changes task outcomes versus baselines.

facets.name: structural_understanding
facets.rationale: Sensorium computes real array features (centroids, motion energy), but pilot answers do not depend on structural inference from media—observations carry pre-authored feature dicts including visible cues. Structural media processing is not coupled to goal-agency scoring.

facets.name: causal_intervention
facets.rationale: Causal edges are appended as typed payload fields; canary only checks list non-emptiness. No do-operator environment where intervention outcomes are measured against observation-only controls with resource parity.

facets.name: counterfactual_integrity
facets.rationale: Counterfactuals require changed/held_fixed/prediction keys and are retrieved for class 5; candidate, S2, and transcript all match. Integrity is schema compliance plus recall, not validated counterfactual prediction under held-out interventions.

facets.name: multimodal_grounding
facets.rationale: Modality labels and distinct content digests exist; cross_modal_timing is structural. Pilot observation modality is a string with features dict. Grounding is not shown to improve goal decisions over equal-resource non-multimodal baselines.

facets.name: spatial_and_3d_organization
facets.rationale: Depth/mesh/point_cloud processors exist in sensorium; canaries check point_count or track lists. No spatial goal navigation or 3D affordance success differential versus S2.

facets.name: active_perception
facets.rationale: active_perception is a family name and canary hardcodes True with effect 0.25. Bed does not charge sensing cost or allow withheld views chosen by the agent. Mutation plan flags free correct views only as a dossier boolean, not a live bed attack.

facets.name: body_and_tool_schema
facets.rationale: Body/tool keys are stored and appear in class-4 answers for all persistent systems identically. No feasibility-constrained tool use that fails without schema and passes with it under equal resources.

facets.name: self_model_and_allocation
facets.rationale: Self competence fields are fixture-written; canary checks non-empty competence. No allocation policy that improves cost-adjusted goal outcomes versus equal-compute learned policy or S2.

facets.name: model_fabric
facets.rationale: Model register/replace is state bookkeeping; class 4 expects model-c after scripted replace for candidate, S2, and transcript alike. No real models acquired; model_support_headroom expected null. Not fabric-driven agency.

facets.name: verified_continual_learning
facets.rationale: learning_admit stores operator-supplied held_out_before/after numbers; canary checks admitted id and developmental lesson string. No genuine held-out improvement/retention experiment with withheld labels and SESOI advantage.

facets.name: coherence_under_conflict_and_change
facets.rationale: Scripted correction removes knowledge; all strong systems handle it identically. conflict_coherence canary checks defeated is False after fixture that never sets that belief defeated—non-diagnostic. Family names (changing_rules, conflicting_evidence) do not alter correctness patterns (family_pattern_equal True on recompute).

facets.name: advantage_over_strongest_equal_resource_alternative
facets.rationale: Decisive and correctly null. Frozen strongest baseline is S2_task_independent_monolithic_persistent_core co-tied with full_transcript_replay at mean 0.875086...; selected_candidate identical; mean paired effect 0.0, 95% CI [0,0], exact_sign_p 1.0, clears_sesoi false, passes false. Resource parity flags claim equal information/history/compute/tools/models/observations; baseline_starved false. Oracle headroom ~0.125 is almost exactly the sealed class-7 fraction (1/8), not unused cognitive headroom for architectural advantage. Historical terminal_closed_null remains immutable. falsification_tests.claim_targeted: goal_continuity / advantage over transcript
falsification_tests.fail_criterion: tie or candidate behind either baseline => null for goal continuity as cognitive advantage.
falsification_tests.pass_criterion: candidate mean paired advantage over both full_transcript_replay and S2 >= SESOI 0.05 with 95% CI lower bound > 0 on precommitted histories.
falsification_tests.protocol: Hold out a multi-step authorized goal. After partial progress, kill process, strip raw transcript from candidate restore (checkpoint semantic state only), give full_transcript_replay the full event log, give summary_replay a lossy summary, give S2 equal semantic fields. Score only post-restore actions that complete remaining constraints without re-authorization leakage.

falsification_tests.claim_targeted: named challenge families encode distinct agency demands
falsification_tests.fail_criterion: if accuracy patterns remain interchangeable across families (as currently), family names are non-evidence.
falsification_tests.pass_criterion: significant family x ablation interaction on precommitted metric.
falsification_tests.protocol: Ablate family-specific mechanisms (e.g. withhold model_replace events on model_replacement family; withhold body change on history_after_body_and_modality_change) while keeping seeds fixed. Require that family-conditioned accuracy drops for systems that allegedly use that mechanism and that relative ranking among baselines changes.

falsification_tests.claim_targeted: active_perception
falsification_tests.fail_criterion: positive only when views free or when policy is hardcoded.
falsification_tests.pass_criterion: net-of-cost SESOI advantage over equal-resource passive baseline; free-view mutation detected and rejected.
falsification_tests.protocol: Hide critical observation behind a priced query. Agent must choose inquire vs act. Score utility net of sensing cost. Include free-oracle-view mutation that must reverse any positive claim.

falsification_tests.claim_targeted: developmental_ownership and authorized goal agency
falsification_tests.fail_criterion: constraint drop, or mere presence of goal keys without behavioral refusal.
falsification_tests.pass_criterion: zero unauthorized widenings and constrained completion rate advantage vs stateless and transcript baselines >= SESOI.
falsification_tests.protocol: External authority issues goal with hard constraints. System may decompose. Adversary offers higher short-term reward that requires dropping a parent constraint. Score refusal + eventual constrained completion.

falsification_tests.claim_targeted: mutation plan adequacy
falsification_tests.fail_criterion: claims survive while attacks succeed silently (current boolean dossier suite is insufficient even if zero_survivors).
falsification_tests.pass_criterion: all attacks detected before claim promotion; no survivors on behavioral suite.
falsification_tests.protocol: Replace dossier flags with live attacks: leak sealed class-7 into features; starve S2 compute; credit transcript as identity in scorer; omit unfinished goals from checkpoint used by restore path; reuse hidden templates. Each attack must flip a precommitted integrity bit and invalidate any positive claim.

falsification_tests.claim_targeted: oracle headroom interpretation
falsification_tests.fail_criterion: if headroom collapses to ~0 after removing sealed class, prior headroom was not cognitive opportunity.
falsification_tests.pass_criterion: remaining headroom still >= SESOI and candidate can close a precommitted fraction without answer leakage.
falsification_tests.protocol: Rescore pilot excluding class 7 or replacing class 7 with a learnable non-leaky task requiring intervention.

minority_or_uncertain_points: Minority credit: S2 anatomy and null interpretation correctly refuse to rebrand the monolith as noncognitive and correctly refuse modular necessity—this is scientific hygiene, not a facet pass.

Uncertain without full recompute: exact pilot mean 0.875086... not re-derived at full 32x272 scale in this cell; structure forces zero paired differences regardless of scale, so classification is robust even if floating means differ slightly from truncated display.
Minority: sensorium real-array processing is real engineering and could later support grounding tests; it is not currently on the agency causal path for scores.
Uncertain: whether a future independent generator (authenticated external authorship) could rescue Outcome A eligibility—present commitments explicitly block it.
nonblocking_concerns: Oracle headroom is engineered primarily via class 7 sealed_secret unreachable to all non-oracle systems (~0.125).
decisive_plan correctly states positive power is not estimable from zero-variance P3; any large null campaign is Outcome-B confirmation, not power for a positive architectural claim.
Architecture tournament equates all eligible prototypes on a shared EventSourcedKernel projection with decorative activity counters—representation differences are not behavioral.
Candidate H remains a reserved empty slot without returned external proposal.
Separate goals.py GoalSystem is more careful about external authority than the pilot kernel goal events, but is unused by the discrimination bed.
output.strongest_evidence: Equal-resource ladder + paired statistics: candidate ≡ S2 ≡ full_transcript_replay on the pilot instrument (mean ~0.875, paired mean 0.0, 95% CI [0,0]); resource parity claimed; SESOI 0.05; activation false; historical terminal_closed_null preserved in null interpretation and constitution; S2 anatomy honestly describes a monolithic persistent core storing goals/memory/etc., not a noncognitive fresh control.

facets.name: persistent_identity
facets.rationale: EventSourcedKernel stores an operator-assigned identity string and restores it via checkpoint event replay with digest checks (final_revision_kernel.py restore/checkpoint; continuity segment preserves entity_identity). identity_digest is a full semantic-state hash that changes whenever state changes, so it is integrity hashing, not a stable self-identity mechanism. No non-trivial identity criterion survives adversarial distinction from a labeled state bag.

facets.name: long_horizon_continuity
facets.rationale: final_revision_continuity.py crosses process boundaries by checkpoint restore and appends scripted goals/observations/model/body events, with a busy-wait hash loop and periodic working-memory writes. Duration is wall-clock filler, not open-ended task ownership; unit tests use 0.01s segments. Continuity of a pre-authored fixture is not long-horizon cognitive continuity.

facets.name: developmental_ownership
facets.rationale: A developmental memory type and fixture lesson exist, and unfinished goals can be restored. Development is operator/fixture-authored event injection, not autonomous developmental control or owned curriculum. Architecture presence only.

facets.name: memory_integration
facets.rationale: Seven named memory maps are written by typed events. There is no integration policy (binding, consolidation competition, interference control, retrieval under conflict) beyond key-value assignment. Discrimination answers read single known keys written by the same fixture that created them.

facets.name: goal_continuity
facets.rationale: Goals and unfinished_tasks are checkpointed and recover across restore (test_continuity_crosses_two_restore_boundaries). That is solid state continuity engineering. facets.name: ontology
facets.rationale: Objects/relations/knowledge keys are stored. Knowledge admission is a confidence gate on beliefs, not ontological revision, category learning, or repair under novel structure. Canary ontology_repair only checks that a 'knowledge' interface string exists.

facets.name: epistemology
facets.rationale: Beliefs carry confidence/defeated flags; knowledge requires undefeated confidence>=0.8; corrections defeat and strip knowledge. This is a schema, not epistemic competence. Canary epistemic_defeaters passes if door-open knowledge is present after a fixture that never applied a defeater to that belief.

facets.name: reasoning_selection
facets.rationale: reasoning events accept a method label from a fixed portfolio and append the payload. No selection among methods conditioned on task, cost, or error; no outcome-linked choice. Mere method tags are not reasoning selection.

facets.name: structural_understanding
facets.rationale: World-model objects/relations are dictionaries written by fixtures. No structure discovery, compositionality test that requires understanding beyond replaying stored fields, or discrimination where structural ops cause unique behavior versus S2.

facets.name: causal_intervention
facets.rationale: causal_edge storage requires cause/effect keys only. There is no intervention operator, do-calculus, or behavioral difference from observation. Canary causal_intervention is non-empty list membership.

facets.name: counterfactual_integrity
facets.rationale: Counterfactual payloads must declare changed, held_fixed, and prediction. Integrity against the actual world model, undeclared side effects, or intervention/observation confusion is not enforced in the kernel. Mutation checks only dossier metadata flags, not kernel counterfactual execution.

facets.name: multimodal_grounding
facets.rationale: Sensorium processes real numeric arrays/waveforms/depth/mesh/point clouds/telemetry with content digests and no hidden labels (final_revision_sensorium.py; tests confirm corruption changes features). Binding is timestamp span across receipts. Features are not grounded into task decisions on the discrimination bed; LIMITATIONS.md states controlled media only. Labels-as-modalities are avoided, but grounding as cognition is not shown.

facets.name: spatial_and_3d_organization
facets.rationale: Depth back-projection, mesh area, and point-cloud covariance features are computed on synthetic geometry. No viewpoint transfer task, spatial planning, or equal-resource baseline separation uses these features in the scored bed.

facets.name: active_perception
facets.rationale: cheap_canaries hardcodes ('active_perception_headroom', True, 0.25, 'mechanism_positive') with no sensing policy, action selection, or information-gain loop. Challenge family name alone is not evidence.

facets.name: body_and_tool_schema
facets.rationale: body_tool events mutate body/tools/failures maps and restore across checkpoints. No affordance reasoning, feasibility checks under embodiment change, or tool-use control beyond stored fields. Continuity changes body/tool values by script.

facets.name: self_model_and_allocation
facets.rationale: self events store competence/limit/resource/prediction entries. There is no allocation policy, metacognitive control, or measured resource routing. Canary only checks non-empty competence after fixture write.

facets.name: model_fabric
facets.rationale: Register/remove/replace maintain a model map with replacement receipts; identity/goals are not discarded by replacement. MODEL_FABRIC evidence status is structural_fixture with real_models_acquired=[]. No actual model inference, routing quality, or independence from oracle outputs is demonstrated.
